text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, pant... Ya beat me!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
She's so tough! There's no way I can
match that
resolve...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
The fateful battle has been decided! The
winner
of this year's Arima Kinen is...
Super Creek!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! I'm a Grand Prix
winner! And
that means...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: You're a Grand Prix trainer!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I should be the one thanking you! I... I
just...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, come and join me in the winner's
circle!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone. I'm Супер Крик, the
former
villain. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I'm actually just a
motherly
Umamusume who wants to
coddle her trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support
today!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: You can coddle me anytime!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're all very important to me, so
I want
you all to listen to what I have to
say!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Please be careful on your way home. The
Arima
Kinen isn't over until you're back
safe!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Okaaay!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
A unified response. Супер Крик appears
to have
captured everyone's hearts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Right, I'd like to finish off with some
special
congratulations.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Now that my trainer has become number
one in
the world, I'd like to offer a
reward as a way of
expressing my
gratitude.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She pulls me out to stand in front of
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You've really become so capable,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
And it's thanks to you that I've been
able to
achieve such wonderful results
over these past
three years.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: But my career is hardly about results.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's about you and me, and everything
we've built
together. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: We both try to hold back our tears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You've done such a great job. Okay,
here I go...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Who's a good Тренер?! You are! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes and soak it in. There's
nothing like
getting praised and patted
when you're on top of
the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I have no idea what's
happening.
My body is enveloped in a
strange sensation...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And I soon find myself wrapped in Super
Creek's
warm embrace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming into my life. I'm so
glad to
have met you... You are my
everything!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
My body trembles with emotion as I
continue to
look up towards the sky,
unable to even hug her
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm finally a first-class trainer. The sky
should feel
distant and unreachable...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yet now, as Супер Крик holds me up in
her tight
embrace, it feels so very close.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
